facts.fact: BCEAO developed and runs the PI-SPI instant payment platform, in service in Togo with 17 connected providers and 24-hour operation, per TogoTimes.
Togo's providers are connected to the WAEMU-wide PI-SPI, with about 3.9 million Togo users at end-October 2026, per TogoTimes.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money issuers, microfinance institutions, payment institutions
